characters.continuity: Pokémon Generation I-IX games and anime
characters.summary: Machoke is a formidable Fighting-type Pokémon that relies on its heavily muscled physique, superhuman strength, and martial arts strikes to overwhelm opponents in close combat.

mechanisms: Durable muscular frame that resists physical blows

mobility: Walking and running at high athletic speeds
limitations: Relies strictly on close-quarters physical combat
Vulnerable to special attacks, particularly Psychic and Fairy types

sources.supports: Abilities, typing, moves, and physical description of Machoke.

feats.claim: Possesses enough physical strength to effortlessly lift a sumo wrestler.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

unknowns: Exact lifting limits in metric tons vary slightly across different Pokédex entries.

characters.summary: Machop is a compact Fighting-type Pokémon that builds its muscles by lifting heavy boulders and sparring constantly, utilizing close-range physical martial arts.

limitations: Limited exclusively to close-range combat
Prone to being outmaneuvered by flying or aerial opponents

sources.supports: Abilities, physical attributes, and movepool of Machop.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Generation I-IX games and anime
characters.summary: Magikarp is widely known as a notoriously weak Water-type Pokémon that can barely move on land, relying mostly on frantic splashing until it evolves.

mechanisms: Heavy scales that provide minimal baseline physical defense

limitations: Almost entirely defenseless and immobile on dry land
Attacks like Splash inflict no direct damage

sources.supports: Stats, baseline moves like Splash, and evolutionary background.

feats.claim: Can leap high over mountains using its Splash technique despite its weak appearance.

campaignTags.claim: Magikarp is a water-dwelling Pokémon capable of swimming in rivers and oceans.

mechanisms: Sturdy skeletal skull helmet protecting its head

limitations: Dependent on retaining its bone weapon for maximum offensive output
Vulnerable to moisture and plant-based attacks

limitations: Susceptible to multiple elemental vulnerabilities including Ground, Water, Ghost, and Dark
Requires its bone club to perform specialized spiritual attacks

limitations: Vulnerable to Fighting-type combatants
Limited physical mass makes it weak against heavy physical impacts
